item.title: Kagoshima Events 2026: Kinko Bay Fireworks, Ohara Matsuri & Sakurajima
item.description: Kagoshima lives in the shadow of Sakurajima, one of the world’s most active volcanoes, which smokes across the bay from the city every day. Its 2026 event calendar matches that drama: Kyushu’s largest fireworks display over Kinko Bay, southern Japan’s biggest street dance festival, and the year-round spectacle of the volcano itself. Add the steaming sand baths of Ibusuki and the ancient forests of Yakushima offshore, and Kagoshima rewards a well-timed 2026 trip.
